CheckTitle: All EIPs are associated with a resource
Description: Ensure that no unassociated Elastic IPs (EIPs) exist in the account.
Risk: Unassociated EIPs incur unnecessary costs and may be inadvertently attached to resources, potentially exposing them to the internet.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Elastic IP.
3. Identify EIPs with no associated resource.
4. Release the unassociated EIPs.

Recommendation.Text: Release any EIPs that are not bound to a resource.

Notes: Checks for EIPs that are not bound to any resource (port_id is null).
